tagline: Leading provider of retirement, asset management and wealth management solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of the health and scale of the integrated financial services platform, reflecting the company's ability to manage assets for its institutional and individual clients

kpis.name: Assets Under Management and Administration
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed and administered by the company on behalf of its clients
kpis.description: The company manages and administers $1.1 trillion in assets for its institutional and individual clients as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Key indicator of the financial health and reach of the platform

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue derived from fee income, insurance premiums, and investment income
kpis.description: Revenue is generated from three primary sources: fee revenue, premium revenue, and investment income
kpis.signal: Key indicator of the company's growth and profitability

kpis.name: RGA Reinsurance Transaction
kpis.explanation: Reinsurance agreement with RGA to cede 75% of the in-force individual life insurance block
kpis.description: On July 31, 2025, EQH completed a reinsurance agreement with RGA, ceding 75% of the individual life insurance block and closed blocks, with a collateral asset deposit and investment management by AllianceBernstein for approximately 70% of the reserve assets
kpis.signal: Strategic risk management transaction aimed at optimizing capital and reserves

risks.title: Financial Markets and Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Global capital markets conditions and the economy materially affect the company's business, operating results, and financial condition. Significant exposure to equity markets, interest rates, and capital markets volatility noted on pages 35-36

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity threats and data breaches can have a material impact on reputation and financial results. Language emphasizing the importance of client and corporate data protection on page 36

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations materially affect results, derivative portfolios, and insurance products. Declines in rates in 2025 mentioned on pages 35 and 54

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Unfavorable credit conditions can materially impact liquidity and financial results. Significant investment portfolio sensitive to credit conditions noted on page 36

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes affect statutory reserves, capital requirements, and profitability. Ongoing refinements to capital requirements and new reserve standards mentioned on page 54

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operational failures can affect the company's reputation and financial results. Language highlighting the importance of operational management on page 37

risks.title: Catastrophic and Geopolitical Events
risks.score_rationale: Natural disasters and geopolitical crises (Ukrainian conflict, Middle East tensions) can have a material impact. Exposure noted on pages 37 and 54

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies was found in EQH's 10-K/20-F filing
